import org.apache.http.HttpResponse;
import org.apache.http.client.HttpClient;
import org.apache.http.client.methods.HttpGet;
import org.apache.http.client.methods.HttpPost;
import org.apache.http.entity.StringEntity;
import org.apache.http.impl.client.DefaultHttpClient;
import org.apache.http.util.EntityUtils;
import org.glassfish.jersey.internal.util.Base64;
import java.io.IOException;
/**
* Created by U_M0G97 on 13.02.2015.
*/
public class SimpleRestClient {
    private String username = "usssr55_1";
    private String pwd = "secre11093";
    private String stashApplicationURL = "http://039512:7990/stash";
    private String stashProjectsRestServiceURL = "/rest/api/1.0/projects";
    public void createProject(String projectKey, String projectName, String projectDescription) throws IOException {
        String userpass = this.username + ":" + this.pwd;
        String basicAuth = new String( (new Base64()).encode(userpass.getBytes()) );
        HttpClient httpClient = new DefaultHttpClient();
        try {
            HttpPost requestPost = new HttpPost(stashApplicationURL+stashProjectsRestServiceURL);
            requestPost.addHeader("Authorization","Basic " + basicAuth);
            requestPost.setHeader("content-type", "application/json");
            requestPost.setHeader("Accept", "application/json");
            /**
             * Далее формируется JSON-строка, передающая следующие параметры:
             {
             "key": "PRJ",
             "name": "My Cool Project",
             "description": "The description for my cool project.",
             }
             *
             */
            StringEntity requestParams = new StringEntity("{\"key\":" + "\"" + projectKey+ "\"" +   ",\"name\":" + "\"" +  projectName + "\"" +  ",\"description\":" + "\"" +  projectDescription + "\""  + "}");
            System.out.println("request params: " + requestParams);
            requestPost.setEntity(requestParams);
            HttpResponse response = httpClient.execute(requestPost);
            System.out.println( "Response:" + response.getStatusLine() );
            System.out.println(EntityUtils.toString(response.getEntity()));
        } catch (Exception e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        } finally {
            httpClient.getConnectionManager().shutdown();
        }
    }
    public void getProjects() throws IOException {
        String userpass = this.username + ":" + this.pwd;
        String basicAuth = new String( (new Base64()).encode(userpass.getBytes()) );
        HttpClient httpClient = new DefaultHttpClient();
        try {
            HttpGet requestGet = new HttpGet(stashApplicationURL+stashProjectsRestServiceURL);
            requestGet.addHeader("Authorization","Basic" + basicAuth);
            HttpResponse response = httpClient.execute(requestGet);
            System.out.println( "Response:" + response.getStatusLine() + response.getEntity().toString() );
        } catch (Exception e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        } finally {
            httpClient.getConnectionManager().shutdown();
        }
    }
}
